implement.name: Closed event catalogue
implement.summary: An event is sent only if the specification lists it, and the code holds the same list as a typed constant

implement.name: One module owns the tracker
implement.summary: Pages declare events by attribute; only the measurement module touches the tracker queue

implement.name: Cleaned addresses
implement.summary: The address sent is the path template, with no query, no fragment and a referrer reduced to its origin

implement.name: Direct send on the site's domain
implement.summary: The module posts a body with only the listed keys to the tool's collection on the site's own domain; no vendor script, no CORS, the policy unchanged

implement.name: The proxy opens one route
implement.summary: Only the collection route is relayed, bounded and logged nowhere; the proxy writes the client address and the tool reads that header first

implement.name: The measurement never touches the page
implement.summary: It starts when the page is loaded and idle, swallows every failure, and a test proves a throw, a rejection and an unreachable collection change nothing

implement.name: The tool and its database apart
implement.summary: Its own database no application role reads, no outgoing call, administration off the Internet, a purge where the tool has no retention

implement.name: Production only, browser signals honoured
implement.summary: The site identifier is a build setting, empty means nothing is rendered, and the module reads the browser's signals before every send

implement.name: An opt-out that lasts
implement.summary: A control in the privacy policy with its states, a marker the tool respects that outlasts the measurement, and nothing sent when the marker cannot be read

implement.name: Exemption conditions
implement.summary: Fifteen closed questions to answer before a measurement change is called exempt from consent; no cookie is not no tracker; campaigns are outside

implement.name: Auditing audience measurement
implement.summary: Ten questions that find an event outside the catalogue, a direct tracker call, a raw address, a loose body or proxy, a fragile page, a missing signal or opt-out, a shared database, and a failed exemption condition

review.name: An event outside the catalogue or a direct tracker call
review.summary: A name the specification does not list, or a page that reaches the tracker itself, escapes the catalogue and the cleaning

review.name: A raw address sent to the measurement
review.summary: A query string, fragment or variable path segment turns a page count into a record about a person

review.name: A change that leaves the exemption
review.summary: A new event, cookie, field or feature is checked against the fifteen conditions before it merges

review.name: A measurement that reaches the proxy or the database unguarded
review.summary: A route other than the collection, a client address the visitor can choose, or a tool sharing the application's database undoes the separation the exemption assumes
